product_launches.description: Reevo introduced its AI-native Revenue Operating System, a unified GTM platform spanning marketing, sales, and customer success, available to B2B teams today.

overview_description.description: Reevo offers an integrated sales platform that supports go-to-market teams through every stage of the revenue process, from prospecting and outreach to deal closing and post-sale management. It enables users to source and enrich target accounts, run multi-channel sequences, handle email deliverability and dialing, capture meeting recordings and insights, and manage pipelines and forecasts all within a unified interface. Reevo also embeds native AI tools that surface next steps, draft follow-ups, and provide contextual insights across customer interactions so that sales activity is tied directly to meaningful outcomes.

about_short_description.short_description: Reevo is an AI-native revenue operating system that integrates marketing, sales, and customer success into a unified platform.

product.name: Reevo Revenue Operating System
product.description: An AI-native revenue platform that combines CRM, prospecting, outreach, meeting intelligence, deal management, reporting, and workflow automation in one system.

product.name: Reevo Find
product.description: A prospecting and pipeline-building module for sourcing target accounts and contacts, enriching records, routing leads, and activating ideal customer lists.

product.name: Reevo Engage
product.description: A sales engagement module that combines email sequences, mailbox and domain tools, dialing, scheduling, inbox management, and meeting preparation.

product.name: Reevo Win
product.description: A deal execution module that automates activity logging, assists with email composition, analyzes deal health, and identifies risks and next steps.

product.name: Reevo Foundation
product.description: The platform foundation providing CRM records, AI-assisted data access, reporting, workflow automation, and integrations for managing revenue operations.

product.name: Reevo Bot for Slack
product.description: A Slack application that lets authorized users query and update Reevo CRM data, monitor opportunities, and receive sales insights using natural-language prompts.
